major: **Plugins now have their own settings!** Update the ones you have to see them!
**Plugins are now downloaded from Companion instead of the Windows app!**
**Improved accessibility of a few themes!**
**Merged Dash and Overlay into one unified codebase, just switching display names!**
**Removed Compact Mode and Center mode**, as they were good default behavior.
**Improved setup experience!**
Added a page for Contextual library
Sliders have improved behavior!
Themes' warning now display properly
Library no longer uses an exposed HTTP endpoint with your uploads!
Removed 'Performing authenticated action.' notification
Plugin reload, enable, disable, download all have progress bars now!
Removed FreedeckCore.log
Client has Tiles in the center by default
More styling options for themes
Right sidebar gets disabled when its not supposed to be used
The Editor shows you available plugins when hovering over Plugin
Library no longer uses multiple race condition style statements to control UI, instead now event-driven.
Information gathering (initial socket connection) has its own manager and cache now
Improved debug performance
Connect now continuously checks if webpack is compiling
ServerStyleFlags are now ServerFlags
Client's settings menu gets its own script file
Scroll Long Text has improved support!
Migration now removes more logs on start
Moved around the structure: shared and common are merged into /app/shared
Settings and style now wait for consecutive saves within 500ms to write to disk
Updated dependencies
Quicker launcher for Overlay and Companion
Plugin logging is less invasive
Fixed authentication bug: without authentication would be buggy
reload_sounds is now reload_tiles
serverStyleFlagUpdated is now server_flag_updated
FDWS gets its own socket handler!
Webpack attempts to compile at the beginning of the server to improve startup time
PluginV1 are undeprecated **temporarily** until v6.0.0 fully releases
other: A self-tester now exists but unused
Some configs are now made on startup if not existing
And more slight updates to some icons and themes.
